connector.name: Testrail MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for TestRail platform, enabling LLMs to manage test artifacts.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package testrail-mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the uarlouski account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: TESTRAIL_INSTANCE_URL
env.description: Base URL of your TestRail instance (e.g. https://example.testrail.io)

env.name: TESTRAIL_USERNAME
env.description: Email address used to authenticate with TestRail

env.name: TESTRAIL_API_KEY
env.description: API key for authenticating with the TestRail API

env.name: TESTRAIL_ALLOW_WRITE_OPERATIONS
env.description: Allow write operations on TestRail (defaults to true)

env.name: TESTRAIL_ALLOW_READ_OPERATIONS
env.description: Allow read operations on TestRail (defaults to true)

env.name: TESTRAIL_ALLOW_DELETE_OPERATIONS
env.description: Allow delete operations on TestRail (defaults to false)
